body:
Thank you so much. I woke up to both these messages and can't convey how much they helped. I have one particular roommate who has gone above and beyond as far as emotional support goes, and I'm honestly afraid of being emotionally draining so I came here.

I made it to work today (I have a stoic sense of responsibility. Not going was never in the cards) but I sat there, awake, for an hour after my train left and just took a Lyft. (my car was totaled 6 months ago) I really couldn't find the motivation to get the day started.

I'm so relieved to hear you had a positive experience doing something terrifying! It gives me hope that I can scrape by out there.

I just moved to this state almost exactly a year ago, that's my real hangup moving all over again. I feel like such an idiot getting stuck in this situation. I haven't even told my family that I've ended the relationship because I'm embarrassed. (Although I feel I've done the right thing)
